audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer still tells the reader to stun Malphite out of Unstoppable Force in six places (tldr, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[0], report[1], report[5]) while the content layer correctly says it is CC-immune and cannot be cancelled.
audit.why: This is the exact contradiction the mirror audit (malphite__heimerdinger) already resolved on the other side: Unstoppable Force dashes with displacement immunity and cannot be deterred by crowd control. The two directions must not disagree, and a reader who saves an 11s grenade to cancel a 130s charge loses the fight twice — once to the knockup and once to having no answer afterwards.
audit.corrected: Full layer brought in line with the content layer and the mirror everywhere: the grenade is post-knockup insurance, never an R cancel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields say Malphite's W gives him armour that soaks the turret nest, and early names it 'W (Brutal Strikes)'.
audit.why: Thunderclap is the current W and Riot's text gives it a sonic boom with attacks that create aftershocks — no armour, no damage soak. 'Brutal Strikes' is a dead name. The actual soak in his kit is Granite Shield: a layer of rock absorbing up to 10% of his max Health that RECHARGES only if he has not been hit for a few seconds. That flips the advice: it is not something to itemize past, it is something a constantly-ticking turret nest structurally denies him, and the counterplay for HIM is to break contact for a few seconds.
audit.corrected: Thunderclap named correctly and Granite Shield's 10% / recharge-on-no-damage rule written into whys[1], spikes[0], early, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and 'his all-armor build does nothing against you' presented without qualification.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s — the single number that makes 'never sit on flat ground once it is up' concrete. And Ground Slam deals magic damage BASED ON HIS ARMOR on a 7s cooldown, so his armour stacking is not inert against Heimerdinger; it is his damage source in melee range.
audit.corrected: 130s, 8s, 7s written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5] and dontsFull[1].d; the Ground Slam armour-scaling caveat added to whys[5].

audit.why: Full and content charts agree row-for-row (Heim, Heim, Heim, Skill, Heim, Skill, Heim) and the mirror audit explicitly kept this chart. Not touched — changing my side would put the two directions back into disagreement.

notes: MIRROR ALIGNMENT: the malphite__heimerdinger audit already established (web-verified there) that Unstoppable Force is CC-immune and cannot be stunned out of, and fixed the other side. This page's CONTENT layer was already correct but the FULL layer still said 'E-stun his R' in six places, including the TL;DR and the win condition. All six corrected so the two directions agree. Second find, not covered by the mirror: five fields credited Malphite's W with armour that soaks the nest and early called it 'Brutal Strikes' — Thunderclap has no armour component at all. The real soak is Granite Shield (10% max Health, recharges only after a few seconds untouched), which reframes the nest as structurally denying it. Also noted: Ground Slam's damage scales off his armour, so his build is not inert against you at melee range.
